caption: 🎃 Day 3/13 of toddler-friendly Halloween treats & food: Pumpkin Pancakes! These are the perfect little fall breakfast and SO easy to make. 🥞🧡 I used metal Halloween cookie cutters right in the pan to turn them into fun spooky shapes! Toddler Pumpkin Pancakes 🎃 Ingredients: • 1/3 cup pumpkin puree - from @Lidl  • 1 egg • 1/4 cup whole milk - from @Horizon Organic  • 1/2 cup all-purpose flour - from @lidlus  • 1/2 tsp baking powder - from @Trader Joe's  • Dash of cinnamon • Olive oil or unsalted butter for cooking Directions: Add everything to a bowl and mix until combined. Lightly grease your pan and metal Halloween cutters, then place the cutters in the pan and pour in the batter. Cook on low-medium heat until set enough to flip, then cook the other side until golden. Carefully remove from the molds and let cool before serving! Such an easy way to make a regular breakfast feel a little more Halloween-y. 👻🎃 Save this for a spooky October breakfast! 🧡 #toddlerfood #toddlerrecipes #toddlerbreakfast #easyrecipe #fallrecipes
